survey: Public reference of a completed 2-bedroom/2-bathroom apartment commission. One unscaled plan and six tour photos informed the original interpretation. The 11.7 by 9.6 metre indoor bounding box and 2.65 metre ceiling are accepted design estimates, not measurements. No original photo or plan image is bundled.
entrance: For the unchanged demonstration, start inside the south-side foyer at (7.85,1.65,8.9), facing negative Z toward the living room. The front door is static and closed; indoor passages and the balcony opening remain open. A new project requires its own entrance review.
rooms: The demonstration contains primary bedroom, second bedroom, primary bathroom, second bathroom, living/dining room, kitchen, foyer and balcony. Exact authored bounds and openings are in planning.reference.json; they are example geometry and must not be treated as a new user measurement.
furniture: Use the locally authored self-contained assets/apartment.glb: 43 furnishing groups covering beds, storage, sofa, television, tables, kitchen, bathrooms, laundry and balcony furniture. Light wood, neutral walls, dark cabinets and stainless-style appliances are authored materials. The original reference photographs are not distributed.
navigation: Use the unchanged explicit wall segments, furniture blockers, declared routes and 0.22 metre player radius. All eight room access points must be reachable. TV and bedside lamp approaches and the balcony goal must stay accessible; solid structural walls prevent nearby interactions through the wall.
experience: Desktop Chrome demonstration using WASD, drag-look, E, minimap and R reset. Complete television, primary-bedroom lamp, then balcony in order. TV and lamp material states change on correct interaction and reset on replay. Original automated Chrome evidence does not certify Windows, Safari, physical keyboard delivery or photorealistic reconstruction.
